items.headline: Spain chunav: aakhri sarvekshan me PP aage
items.detail: Spain me 29 November ko aam chunav hai — aakhri sarvekshan me Feijoo ki PP 31.8% ke saath aage hai, Sanchez ki PSOE 30.9% par; PP aur Vox ko milkar 188 seatein milne ka anumaan hai.
items.exam_angle: Spain chunav, EU raajneeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia factory aag me 24 mare
items.detail: Shanivaar shaam ko Jakarta ke paas Cikande me PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory me aag lagi — 24 log mare, lagbhag 30 laapata hain; AC short circuit se aag lagne ka shaq hai, bachav kaam jaari hai.

items.headline: Trump: baatchit fail hui to naye hamle
items.detail: Trump ne Fox News se kaha agar Iran se parmanu samjhauta nahi hua to naye saal ke baad bade hamle phir shuru ho sakte hain; unhone 'permanent' samjhote ki maang dohrayi aur naakaabandi todne ki koshish par jahaz doobane ki chetavni di.

items.headline: Bahrain par Iran hamla, 2 ghayal
items.detail: Shanivaar ko Bahrain ke Sitra Island par nagrik audyogik sthal par Iranian hamle me 2 log ghayal hue — IRGC ne kaha usne America ki Patriot vayu-raksha ko nishana banaya; Houthi ne paschimi Saudi ki taraf ballistic missile daagi, jo rok li gayi.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Bahrain, Houthi-Saudi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf drone, Saudi ne roka
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Saudi gathbandhan ne Houthi ka Riyadh kshetra ki taraf aaya drone roka aur gira diya; gathbandhan ke mutabik 24 ghante me roka gaya yeh chautha Houthi hamla hai.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, Riyadh suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Nigeria me naav doobi, 24 mare
items.detail: Shukravar ko Nigeria ke Bayelsa rajya me antim sanskar me ja rahe logon ki naav palat gayi — 24 mare, 24 ko bachaya gaya; NEMA ke mutabik naav me mechanical kharabi thi.

items.headline: Brazil toofan me 5 mare, 250 ghayal
items.detail: Shukravar subah Brazil ke Tupancireta kasbe me supercell toofan ne tabahi machayi — 5 log mare, 250 se zyada ghayal aur lagbhag 8,000 ghar kshatigrast hue; hawa ki raftaar 114 km/h darj hui.

items.headline: South Sudan hamle me 24 nagrik mare
items.detail: Shanivaar raat ko South Sudan ke Warrap rajya ke Bol Bol gaon par SPLA-IO ladakon ne hamla kiya — 24 nagrik mare, jinme 7 bachche bhi hain; hamla padosi Unity rajya se aaya, Rajya sarkar ne 21 mare aur 18 ghayal bataye.
items.exam_angle: South Sudan, SPLA-IO, grih yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Poland me teen Russian Kh-101 missile giri
items.detail: Poland ke abhiyojakon ne Ravivaar ko pushti ki Shukravar ko hawai seema me ghuse teeno vastuein Russian Kh-101 cruise missile thi — malba teen jagah mila, koi hatahat nahi hua; NATO ki baithak Somvaar ko hogi.
items.exam_angle: Poland, NATO, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sparta II ko Finland se kheenchna shuru
items.detail: Drone hamle ke baad Finland ke paani me khade Russian cargo jahaaz Sparta II ko Ravivaar ko kheenchna shuru kar diya gaya — 16 chaalak-dal ke log surakshit nikaale gaye, ek halka ghayal; jahaaz ab sthir hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic, Russia-Ukraine yuddh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: West Bank me aagjani, Eisenkot ne ninda ki
items.detail: Ravivaar raat Ramallah ke paas ke gaonvon me basne walon ne kam se kam 12 gaadiyan jala di — sarkar banane ki koshish kar rahe Gadi Eisenkot ne ise 'Yahudi aatankwad' kaha; koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine, West Bank hinsa — UPSC IR

items.headline: Benghazi me Russian yuddhpot par drone hamla
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Libya ke Benghazi bandargah par khade Russian yuddhpot Merkury par sandigdh drone hamle se dhamaka hua — jahaaz aadha doob gaya aur 10 log halke ghayal hue; Malta ke jhande wala ek vyaparik jahaaz bhi nishana bana.
items.exam_angle: Libya, Russia-Ukraine yuddh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Democrats ko House me 258 seatein
items.detail: North Carolina me Chuck Hubbard ki jeet ke baad Democrats ke paas House me kam se kam 258 seatein ho gayin — 1992 ke baad sabse bada bahumat; chaar seatein abhi bhi tay nahi hui hain.
items.exam_angle: America midterm chunav 2026, House bahumat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kyiv kshetra me drone hamla, 2 mare
items.detail: Ravivaar subah Ukraine ke Kyiv kshetra ke Dymer me Russian drone hamle se paanch-manzila imarat ka hissa gir gaya — nau log nikale gaye. Corrected: ab tak 2 ki maut hui (ek 18 saal ka yuvak), 4 ghayal hue aur 11 log malbe me dabey hain; bachaav kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, drone hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 draft me 'fossil fuels' shabd nahi
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke antim masaude me 'fossil fuels', tel ya koyla ka zikr hi nahi — 2035 tak bijli ki hissedari 35% ka lakshya hai, aur masaude me pehli baar 1.5°C paar hone ki chinta jatai gayi; manzoori par baatchit jaari hai.

items.headline: Bangladesh me hinsa: Narail me ghar jalaye
items.detail: Bangladesh me rajnaitik hinsa jaari hai: Narail me BNP netaon ki hatya ke baad darjanon ghar aur dukanein jalayi gayin, Pabna me bhi jhadap hui; pichhle hafte chaar log mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh rajnaitik sankat, Bharat sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Netanyahu-Eisenkot vaarta bina samjhote khatm
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Herzliya me chaar ghante ki vaarta ke baad Likud aur Yashar me koi samjhota nahi hua — Ben-Gvir ko lekar matbhed barkarar hai, aur Eisenkot ke paas sarkar banane ke liye 6 December tak ka samay hai.

items.headline: Iran ke 14 tanker naakaabandi todne ko taiyar
items.detail: Kharg Island par 14 se zyada tel tanker taiyar hain, dal aur Iran ka jhanda chadha hai; up-mantri ne naakaabandi ko 'yuddh ka kaam' batakar todne ki chetavni di, abhi kafila rawana hone ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Hormuz, tel naakaabandi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Mexico me 'El Chapo Isidro' giraftaar
items.detail: Mexico ki sena ne Sinaloa me chhape me FBI ke 10 most-wanted me se ek Fausto Isidro Meza Flores ko pakda; karwai me 4 sainik aur 7 hamlaavar mare, giraftaari ke baad Sinaloa me hinsa bhadki.
items.exam_angle: Mexico drug cartel, FBI most wanted — UPSC IR
